title: AssuranceWorkState — one small live state (sole owner: controller)
description: Records current status and exact pointers ONLY (V3-D8). Single-writer local scope: no content-addressed event chain, CAS, idempotency protocol or dangling-event recovery. Copied evidence is rejected by additionalProperties:false — every field is an identity, a closed status or a pointer. Cold resume works from this file plus the records it points to (N1-A10).

repair_round.description: 0 = original candidate C; 1 = the single user-approved repair produced C2 (V3-D6).

bind_authorization_ref.description: The user decision that licensed the AssuranceCandidate to be bound, where the licence is not recoverable from any other pointer here. Added in round PROMISE-PATH-VOCAB for the round-0 NO_REPAIR gate: a clean FULL carrying non-blocking findings stops for the user's spend-or-bank choice (R10), and only a recorded NO_REPAIR reaches the candidate — but repair_decision_ref is refused at repair round 0, on the standing ground that a repair authorization cannot precede the repair it authorizes, which a DECLINED repair does not do. So the decision that unlocked the bind reached neither the state nor the candidate and a later reader of an AWAITING_FINAL state could not name it. Digest-protected like the other three user-decision pointers, so it carries the decided bytes and not merely a path. Earliest at AWAITING_FINAL, like every pointer the stage rule covers: a licence cannot exist before the act it licenses.

blockers.description: Present only when something actually blocks. Never an empty placeholder.
